meta.title: Smart TV, IP Camera, PC/Workstation & Network Device Security Exposure
meta.plainExplanation: Performs non-intrusive discovery and security auditing across Smart TVs (Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Roku ECP, Google TV / Android TV / Chromecast, Sony Bravia, Vizio SmartCast, Philips JointSpace, Apple AirPlay, DIAL), IP Cameras / NVRs (RTSP 554/8554, ONVIF SOAP, Hikvision ISAPI, Dahua, Axis, Xiongmai, UniFi Protect, unauthenticated snapshots), PCs / Workstations / Local Servers (Windows SMB/NetBIOS/MSRPC/RDP/WinRM/WSDAPI, macOS/Linux SSH/VNC/CUPS/NFS/AFP/rsync/mDNS, Docker TCP 2375, Ollama 11434, local dev servers, open shares), routers, printers, NAS, and IoT appliances.
meta.whyItMatters: Local network devices and workstations often expose unauthenticated REST/WebSocket control APIs, live RTSP/MJPEG camera feeds, cleartext admin UIs, unauthenticated Docker/Ollama/dev servers, or remote file-sharing and shell services (SMB 445, RDP 3389, WinRM 5985, ADB 5555, Telnet 23) that allow LAN attackers to hijack screens, view surveillance feeds, access files, or execute arbitrary commands.
meta.defaultFix: Segment Smart TVs, IP cameras/NVRs, and IoT appliances onto isolated VLANs with client isolation enabled. Require authentication and HTTPS/TLS on camera and appliance admin interfaces, enforce RTSP Digest auth, disable unused UPnP/DLNA/ADB/Telnet services, bind local dev servers, Docker, and Ollama to 127.0.0.1, and restrict SMB/RDP/WinRM/SSH/VNC/NFS via host firewalls.
meta.remediation: Segment Smart TVs, IP cameras/NVRs, and IoT appliances onto isolated VLANs with client isolation enabled. Require authentication and HTTPS/TLS on camera and appliance admin interfaces, enforce RTSP Digest auth, disable unused UPnP/DLNA/ADB/Telnet services, bind local dev servers, Docker, and Ollama to 127.0.0.1, and restrict SMB/RDP/WinRM/SSH/VNC/NFS via host firewalls.
